QuestInfo.name: Lana's Dream
QuestInfo.0: #p1052121# is convinced you should take an #bacting class#k. What kind of class might it be? Talk to #p1052121# standing in front of the Hair Salon in #bHenesys Market#k.
QuestInfo.1: Maybe #p2152001# isn't the best choice for the head-over-heels expression. #p16052121# asks you to make your own fell in head-over-heels expression.
QuestInfo.2: You are a great actor and a star! In fact, you're too big a star for Big Hit Records to handle! ...or that's what you've heard, anyway. #p1052121# decided to let you go... It seems you won't be a star after all.

0.0: Ah...#h0#. Have you learned to fall in love? ...What do you mean #p2152001#'s expression was phoney? Hm... I was certain he was the guy to learn from. I wonder what happened...
0.1: Well, I'm sure you're right. Why don't you show me your own version of the expression? You haven't been taught it, but I bet you can do it anyway, with your skills.

yes.0: I'll give you a moment to get into character. Let me know when you're ready.

no.0: Don't be so insecure! You're already there!
